Nantong Jianghai.why: Capacitor maker (aluminum electrolytic incl. MLPC / solid-liquid hybrid, film, supercapacitors EDLC / LIC) whose server-power and data-center sales are a stated growth driver; more AI data-center power build-out lifts its capacitor demand.
Nantong Jianghai.evidence: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-21-2026): built new fully automatic snap-in aluminum electrolytic lines suited to data centers; supercapacitor demand in data centers and grid frequency regulation is good and deliveries have reached scale.

players.product: aluminum electrolytic capacitors (incl. MLPC and solid-liquid hybrid), film capacitors and supercapacitors (EDLC / LIC) for server and data-center power

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record, 2025 results briefing) on 2026 capacity plans: aluminum electrolytic - build a fully automatic Snap-in production line version 3.0, complete the design tender for a new manufacturing base, and upgrade technology and expand capacity for solid-liquid hybrid and MLPC products; raise the high-voltage formed-foil self-sufficiency target to 75%. Film capacitors - strengthen in-house supply, cut costs and develop high-end products such as three-phase AC film capacitors, optimise production through the ONE MAKE project. Supercapacitors - technical-upgrade expansion and new production-line planning have started because of growing demand from server power supplies and grid frequency regulation, so capacity can meet batch orders in new applications such as servers and automotive electronics; the supercapacitor technical-upgrade project will release capacity soon. The company will also speed up coordination between its Japanese base and headquarters and study the feasibility of a wholly owned or joint-venture plant overseas.

Management (IR record): the company has won batch orders in server power supplies; its products are now applied across server power supplies at fairly large scale with good feedback, and 2026 will be the first year of scale development in this field. The data-center boom brings big opportunities to all three product categories, and demand will rise in proportion as data-center power rises. 2026 main goal: breakthroughs in several new products and applications, with the artificial-intelligence field substantively becoming a new growth engine for the company.

Management (IR record): 2025 net profit growth was flat mainly because of product price cuts, smaller FX gains as the RMB appreciated and changes in government preferential policies; the Q4 2025 decline (QoQ and YoY) was mainly due to lower product prices and market fluctuations. Aluminum electrolytic capacitors are the main product with better share, brand and scale; the other products are still being cultivated, and management expects the overall gross margin to rise steadily as new products and applications scale up.

Management (IR record) on pricing: products currently sell at prices negotiated with customers at the end of last year, but the company will review changes in raw-material costs and supply-demand and may make partial price adjustments; international uncertainty is disturbing production costs, and it is responding with materials stocked earlier, cost control and supply-chain optimisation.

Management (IR record) on end markets: film-capacitor applications in 2025 were industrial control (25%), new energy (33%), automotive (33%) and consumer electronics. Aluminum electrolytic capacitors have their highest market share in new-energy-vehicle and photovoltaic applications, supercapacitors are in the first tier in energy storage, and film capacitors show growing potential.
